name: Beekeeping gloves
description: White leather gloves with canvas sleeves that reach up the forearm and close with elastic.
notes: Laid flat side by side, backs up, fingers towards +z: white leather gloves with cream canvas sleeves 220 mm long and a white elastic band at the open end. The long sleeves lie spread flat. Slot `hands`, as earlier glove batches use. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Boxing gloves
description: Thick padded leather gloves for punching, strapped at the wrist.
notes: Lying palm down side by side, fingers towards +z: padded red fists turned round z with the thumb along the outer side, a white strap round each cuff and dark lining in the opening. The shell uses `plastic-red` because no bright red leather exists. The padded fists stand 130 mm tall and are drawn as solid. Slot `hands`, as earlier glove batches use. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Hardened steel mail gloves
description: Gloves of hardened steel rings that close over every finger, tied at the cuff with a leather thong.
notes: The model's root: mail in `steel-hardened`. Laid flat side by side, backs up, fingers towards +z: mail gloves 270 mm from cuff to fingertip, ridged where the rows of rings lie, with a leather thong round each flared cuff. The pair lies spread flat with the thumbs out. The xl and xs sizes share the model. Slot `hands`, as earlier glove batches use. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

Slot `hands`, as earlier glove batches use. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Hardened steel demi-gauntlets
description: Leather gloves with mail over the fingers and palm and hardened steel plates over the back of the hand and the wrist.

Plates use `steel-hardened`; mail uses `steel-mail` so the rings read apart from the plates. The mail palm lies face down and does not show. The pair lies spread flat with the thumbs out. The xl size shares the model. Slot `hands`, as earlier glove batches use. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

Tiles draw the `gem-clear` stones opaque; they stay see-through in the game. One glove serves both hands. Slot `hands`, as earlier glove batches use. name: Bag gloves
description: Two plastic bags taped shut at the wrists to keep the hands clean.
